You'll embed with teams across operations, customer success, and finance, find the work that's slow and manual, and ship AI agents and automations that actually get adopted. This is a build-fast, talk-to-humans, own-the-problem role - not a research role and not a pure-infrastructure role. You'll define what "internal AI" looks like here from scratch. Who this is for You're energized by ambiguity and ownership. You'd rather ship a rough tool this week, watch someone use it, and improve it than spend a month on a perfect spec. You like sitting with a non-technical teammate, understanding their actual workflow, and turning it into something that saves them hours. You're comfortable being the only person who owns a problem end to end. Who you will work with You'll partner closely with the CEO and founders on identifying the highest-leverage operational problems to solve and shaping where internal AI goes next.  This is a rare amount of executive access to an engineering role.  You’ll work alongside functional leaders across the business to understand their priorities, surface opportunities , and align on what to build.  Your work will be visible and leadership level from day one.  Operations, Customer Success, Finance, People/Talent Acquisition, Engineering, IT and Data teams, these are your internal customers and collaborators.  You'll embed with them, and learn their workflows and ship tools they actually use.  What you'll actually build Examples of the kind of work waiting for you: An agent that drafts customer success replies from our knowledge base and ticket history A Slack-based workflow that routes and pre-fills finance approvals An internal eval harness so we can trust the LLM features we ship A tool that lets the ops team query [internal system] in plain language You won't do all of these at once — you'll pick the highest-impact one, ship it, and move to the next. What we're looking for 1–3 years building software — backend services, internal tools, automations, or API-driven apps. Internships and co-ops count. Strong in TypeScript and/or Python . You've built something with LLMs — an agent, a RAG pipeline, a copilot, a prompt-driven tool — through work, a side project, or coursework. We care that you've shipped, not where. Comfortable wiring systems together: APIs, webhooks, SaaS integrations, async workflows. You can talk to non-technical stakeholders, figure out what they really need, and drive adoption — this matters as much as the code. You move fast under ambiguity and iterate from real feedback. Omnichannel Outbound & Lead Generation Run multi-channel outreach across email, LinkedIn, and administrative calling to activate early interest and secure meetings. Account-Based Engagement & Territory Support Partner with AVPs to tailor account-specific ABM plays using provided templates and messaging frameworks. Maintain and continuously refine Sales Navigator filters to ensure the right personas and accounts stay in focus. Build and maintain relationship maps at the opportunity and account level to track influence, organizational structure, and decision pathways. Ensure all relevant contacts are captured, enriched, and updated within Salesforce. Manage account specific paperflite landing pages for prospect accounts Discovery Support & Insight Capture Participate in early discovery calls (typically led by the AVP) to gather essential account context, pain points, and opportunity signals. Take clear, structured notes and capture the information required to satisfy discovery-stage exit criteria. Conduct light pre-call research to support AVP preparation and call strategy. Sales Enablement & Collateral Preparation Create v1 slideware or call prep materials using approved templates and automation tools for Qualify and Discovery conversations. Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable reaching out to new stakeholders and handling gatekeepers. Strong organization and note-taking skills; able to manage multiple accounts and opportunities simultaneously. High resilience, persistence, and comfort engaging in outbound motions. Our platform helps health systems optimize patient flow, reduce length of stay, improve discharge planning, and drive surgical growth and OR utilization through AI-powered workflows and predictive analytics. In this role, you will serve as the technical expert for our suite of products — communicating requirements to external clients and internal teams, managing hospital-specific data transformations, building custom EHR integrations, executing product configuration and data validation, and supporting clinical workflow rollouts. You will work closely with hospital stakeholders and R&D counterparts to deliver scalable, high-quality data pipelines that drive measurable improvements across inpatient operations and surgical growth. Key Responsibilities Communicate technical product requirements and provide support to external clients and internal development teams, ensuring optimal utilization of Qventus modules; gather and analyze user requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and develop configuration plans with appropriate timelines. Lead technical implementations of Qventus solutions end-to-end, including Inpatient Operations and Surgical Growth: validate clinical data sources, configure relevant capacity and workflow metrics (e.g., bed capacity, discharge planning, OR scheduling and case volume), and manage the full lifecycle from requirements through unit testing and customer sign-off. Query relational databases and configure technical systems including Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems; develop monitoring mechanisms and automated alerts to proactively identify and prevent production data quality issues. Collaborate with Integration teams to identify and resolve data interoperability issues; perform root cause analysis on data pipeline failures, evaluate HL7/FHIR integration configurations, and implement corrections both historically and going forward. Manage and execute data migrations from legacy hospital systems, minimizing disruption to patient care while maintaining data integrity throughout the transition. Direct production support for customer issues post-deployment: actively monitor support channels, own issues from identification through resolution, and coordinate across internal teams to restore normal system function. Develop deployment-related technical content and training materials, including starter content for product modules; deliver advanced technical training to new employees and customer teams, presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Identify process gaps within product administration and configuration; perform analysis to design optimal workarounds or reconfigurations, and make detailed technical recommendations to resolve platform deficiencies. Participate in technical architecture discussions for hospital system integrations; identify improvements to Qventus solutions in collaboration with R&D partners and contribute to scalable, long-term platform evolution. What We’re Looking For Demonstrated experience building, debugging, and enhancing production healthcare data transformation pipelines; highly proficient in SQL and at least one modern data warehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, BigQuery). 3+ years of professional experience with modern programming languages such as Java, C/C++, or Python, with a dedication to high code quality. Experience translating hospital requirements into technical designs for hospital operations (inpatient and/or surgical) and executing across multiple technologies and platforms in fast-paced environments (AWS preferred). Understanding of healthcare data structures related to hospital operations, such as bed management, patient flow, OR scheduling, or surgical case volume; familiarity with relational database technologies including Redshift and RDS. Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to articulate technical issues clearly to clinical leadership, hospital IT teams, and non-technical stakeholders alike. It’s a Plus if You Have… Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Experience with HL7, FHIR, or other healthcare data standards; familiarity with integration middleware such as Mirth or Rhapsody. EHR system integration experience (Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and aptitude for interpreting complex clinical datasets, including length of stay, discharge barriers, bed utilization, OR block scheduling, or surgical case data. Hands-on experience with dbt, Terraform, Looker, and/or Ansible; background building hospital performance metrics and real-time clinical monitoring systems. jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.description: On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise. Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We’re inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations. #LI-MB1   We’re building a product organization at Qventus where the best PMs don’t just write specs and shepherd backlogs, but actually build. You’ll own a high-growth product area at the intersection of generative AI and healthcare, and you’ll spend real time prototyping, automating, and creating alongside engineering and design rather than watching from the sidelines. This is an emerging, fast-evolving role.  We’re looking for someone with the drive and adaptability to help define what “builder-mode” product management looks like as we go, rather than someone waiting for a fully settled playbook. This is the scope of the role and the work you’ll actually do: Own a product area end-to-end. Take responsibility for a high-growth generative AI and healthcare product area, including its strategy, roadmap, and the decision on what gets built and why. Define and manage the outcomes. Set the measurable outcomes for your area, instrument the metrics behind them, and use those numbers as the primary signal of whether the work is succeeding. Discover and validate opportunities. Develop a deep understanding of your users, the market, the technology, and the data, and use it to find and validate the problems most worth solving. Set the vision and requirements. Define the vision, the problems to solve, and the requirements for the solutions, and align the team and leadership behind them. Get hands-on in the product through building : prototype with AI tools, mockup flows, and draft working solutions alongside engineering and design, automating the routine parts of the PM job as you go. Lead a cross-functional team. Partner closely with engineers, data scientists, designers, and clinical experts to ship products that solve meaningful problems, then iterate after launch based on real impact. Be the face of the product. Build relationships with users, buyers, and external thought leaders, and represent the product credibly with everyone from front-line clinicians to C-suite executives. What we’re looking for These are the qualities, skills, and experience we’re hiring for. Core (the things that matter most) High ownership and accountability. You take full responsibility for your product area and its results, and you drive things forward rather than wait to be driven. You are highly communicative regarding deadlines, progress, and expected outcomes. Outcome-oriented and data-strong. You instinctively frame success as measurable results, and you let data guide your decisions. Proven “shipper”. You have a track record of rapidly taking products through the full lifecycle and delivering real impact. Exceptional communicator. Above all, you demonstrate outstanding written communication skills; you are crisp, structured, and persuasive on the page. You have. strong verbal communication too, with a confident, professional presence in front of customers and partners, including C-suite executives. High motor. You thrive in a very fast-moving environment, with a strong bias to action and the energy to keep multiple things moving without dropping quality. Hands-on with AI. You are fluent and comfortable using AI tools day-to-day, ideally building and prototyping with them, and willing to learn as new tools and technologies develop High comfort level with data . You are comfortable developing products that lean heavily on data, analytics, and machine learning. Strong product sense and taste. You have a real eye for great product and user experience, and the instinct to tell the difference between good and great. Personable and customer-facing. You are collaborative, easy to work with, and the kind of person customers and partners across all functions of an enterprise SaaS healthcare technology business (such as engineering, professional services, sales, delivery) trust. Adaptable. You are comfortable with ambiguity in a newer, evolving PM model, and eager to grow into a builder-mode operating style as the role takes shape. Able to span altitudes. You can move from vision and evangelism down into the weeds, with high attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Nice to have Healthcare familiarity. Exposure to healthcare operations or clinical workflows is a plus but not required. We’ll help the right person come up to speed.
